import.title: Import old receipts
import.intro: Upload a CSV file of receipts from the paper register. They are added to the register as imported records.
import.rule1: Columns: serialNo, date, memberName, membershipNo (optional), amount, purpose, utr (optional).
import.rule2: Dates can be 2025-04-12 or 12/04/2025. Receipts whose number already exists are skipped.
import.rule3: New online receipts continue after the highest imported number of the same year, for example R/26-27/0451 is followed by 0452.
import.tooBig: This file is too large. Please split it into smaller files.
